<div class="inner-page">
<p class="section-label">News</p>

<h1>EKHI Database Launched</h1>

<p>We are pleased to announce the launch of <strong>EKHI</strong>, a curated open database of 1&nbsp;251 curves digitised from the TPRC Data Series (1970&ndash;72), traceable to 167 source publications.</p>

<p>EKHI provides publication-centered data organization with curve-level spectral datasets, inspection and download mechanisms, and full provenance tracking. Researchers can browse, visualize, and download emissivity, reflectance, transmittance, and absorptance spectra.</p>

<p><a href="/data/ekhi.html">Read the full EKHI application note</a> for details on the database structure, data formats, and how to contribute your measurements.</p>

<p>EKHI is described in detail in our paper in <a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-026-07083-9"><em>Scientific Data</em> (2026)</a>.</p>

<p><a href="https://ekhi.ehu.eus" class="btn btn-primary">Access the EKHI Database</a></p>
